title: A Bochner-type integration theory for random normed modules
summary: We develop a measure and integration theory for random normed modules. Given a probability space $({\rm X},Σ,\mathfrak m)$, we introduce and study measures taking values into the space $L^0(\mathfrak m)$ of $\mathfrak m$-measurable functions quotiented up to $\mathfrak m$-a.e. equality. Moreover, we develop a Bochner-type integration theory with respect to an $L^0(\mathfrak m)$-valued measure $μ$, for maps whose target ${\rm M}$ is a complete random normed module with base $({\rm X},Σ,\mathfrak m)$, or equivalently an $L^0(\mathfrak m)$-Banach $L^0(\mathfrak m)$-module.
